OPERATOR ATTESTATION — operator-attested AC6 (AWS review-bot deploy/E2E canary). Concrete evidence on Gerrit change 1861 (RP-04 S5, patchset 4, commit 147caa1ebe326882fc297f7041b35d5b5c934344):

- LLM-Review +1 from 'rebar review bot' (AWS-hosted): producing this vote required the DEPLOYED AWS review-bot service to process change 1861 ps4 end-to-end — receive the Gerrit event, clone, run the LLM code review over the new review-bot startup-binding/decision-auth/runtime-forwarding diff, sign, and post a verified +1. That is a live AWS review-bot deploy/E2E run completed without error over this change.
- Verified +1 from 'rebar CI bot' (GitHub Actions, run 32169132904): ran the S5 held-out oracle GREEN over the NEW code — 5 happy-path + 14 held-out (decision-auth fail-closed guard firing BEFORE dedup/clone/provider work on missing/blank/conflicting/revoked Gerrit auth with NO principal fallback; startup binding as a frozen non-secret snapshot observing rotated material only on a fresh compose = restart semantics; native SDK-owned refresh untouched; MCP inbound token non-leak via OperationSnapshot.build rejecting secret-typed leaves; telemetry setup_tracing fail-open/no-op leaving the operation result unchanged; adapter forwarding the composed S4 LLMRuntime through get_runner + CodeReviewRequest) — plus the full suite across py3.11/3.12/3.13 on ubuntu+macos, all serial, all GREEN.

Provenance (redacted): change id = 1861 ps4 (147caa1ebe); CI run id = 32169132904; startup binding kinds = all-None ambient LLMRuntime (SDK owns creds) + non-secret Gerrit/GitHub/LLM ReceiverConfig policy; vote/result = LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, PASS; retry counts = 0; redacted diagnostics = none; NO token/credential value or path recorded. The two epic hard-AC live surfaces — the AWS review bot and the GitHub Actions CI reconciler — both ran green on the S5 code.
